\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 158-161 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R166-first-pass-words-from-chapters-158-161}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a parcel and a postcard.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item ripe, dark, clear, dark-coloured, punctual
  \item a flat, a living room, a corridor, a balcony, an inner wall
  \item the bill, a tip, a pizzeria, a hamlet, a pavement
  \item a court, a judge, a mayor, the town council, elections
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Ripe? (\textbf{maturo}.) Dark? (\textbf{buio}.) Clear? (\textbf{chiaro}.) Dark-coloured? (\textbf{scuro}.) Punctual? (\textbf{puntuale}.) A flat? (\textbf{l'appartamento}.) A living room? (\textbf{il soggiorno}.) A corridor? (\textbf{il corridoio}.) A balcony? (\textbf{il balcone}.) An inner wall? (\textbf{la parete}.) The bill? (\textbf{il conto}.) A tip? (\textbf{la mancia}.) A pizzeria? (\textbf{la pizzeria}.) A hamlet? (\textbf{il villaggio}.) A pavement? (\textbf{il marciapiede}.) A court? (\textbf{il tribunale}.) A judge? (\textbf{il giudice}.) A mayor? (\textbf{il sindaco}.) The town council? (\textbf{il comune}.) Elections? (\textbf{le elezioni}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 162-166 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R166-second-pass-words-from-chapters-162-166}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a website and a screen.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a website, a screen, a keyboard, a battery, a charger
  \item a mechanic, an electrician, a plumber, a worker, an office worker
  \item a girlfriend, a bridegroom, a bride, a widower, failure
  \item a rule, permission, a ban, danger, safety
  \item a signature, an envelope, a stamp, a parcel, a postcard
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A website? (\textbf{il sito}.) A screen? (\textbf{lo schermo}.) A keyboard? (\textbf{la tastiera}.) A battery? (\textbf{la batteria}.) A charger? (\textbf{il caricabatterie}.) A mechanic? (\textbf{il meccanico}.) An electrician? (\textbf{l'elettricista}.) A plumber? (\textbf{l'idraulico}.) A worker? (\textbf{l'operaio}.) An office worker? (\textbf{l'impiegato}.) A girlfriend? (\textbf{la fidanzata}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{lo sposo}.) A bride? (\textbf{la sposa}.) A widower? (\textbf{il vedovo}.) Failure? (\textbf{il fallimento}.) A rule? (\textbf{la regola}.) Permission? (\textbf{il permesso}.) A ban? (\textbf{il divieto}.) Danger? (\textbf{il pericolo}.) Safety? (\textbf{la sicurezza}.) A signature? (\textbf{la firma}.) An envelope? (\textbf{la busta}.) A stamp? (\textbf{il francobollo}.) A parcel? (\textbf{il pacco}.) A postcard? (\textbf{la cartolina}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
